exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-06-06 to 2026-06-12): growthbook.io had 12,673 sessions and 8,135 users (-14.6% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 12,673 sessions (-14.6% WoW) | 8,135 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,392 clicks (+7.0% WoW) | 152,349 impressions (-3.1% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 8,888 GA4 sessions (+3.7% WoW) all-traffic | 1,875 GSC clicks (+6.8% WoW) organic | 13,996 GSC impressions (-13.5% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,289 GA4 sessions (-6.4% WoW) all-traffic | 106 GSC clicks (+14.0% WoW) organic | 5,374 GSC impressions (+13.3% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,393 GA4 sessions (-2.4% WoW) all-traffic | 1,065 GSC clicks (+2.8% WoW) organic | 121,479 GSC impressions (+12.2% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 4,977 GA4 sessions (-36.2% WoW) all-traffic | 320 GSC clicks (+19.0% WoW) organic | 100,688 GSC impressions (-8.0% WoW)
- Note: GSC page-split window (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-07) is unchanged from last week — same data, no new movement to report here. The all-other-pages divergence (GA4 all-traffic down -36.2%, GSC organic clicks up +19.0%) was flagged last week as an AI-search-displacement signal; still holds.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely** published three AI experimentation assets this week: **"Powering AI With Feature Flags"**, **"AI Experimentation Takes With Elena Verna"**, and **"Big Ideas In AI Driven Experimentation"** — all Tier 1. Combined with **"Top 10 Takeaways From The Experimentation Playbook"** (also present this week), Optimizely is running a coordinated AI experimentation content campaign. GrowthBook's **/blog/a-b-testing-in-the-age-of-ai** dropped from 15 to 4 clicks this same week.
- **Flagsmith** published **"GitLab Feature Flags"** (KD 5, Tier 1) — a low-competition developer-ICP post GrowthBook could match quickly. GitLab users are a natural GrowthBook open-source audience.
- **PostHog** CUPED and LLM Prompt Experiments docs continue to appear — fourth consecutive week flagged; no GrowthBook counter-content published.
- **LaunchDarkly** "Run Experiments" solution page, "Feature Flags vs Feature Branching", and "AI Experimentation" blog all carried from last week — no new net-new LD content this week beyond what was previously flagged.
- ⚠️ No new pages detected from **Statsig** or **Unleash** this week — likely a monitoring gap, not a content pause.

**New GrowthBook content**
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** (published 2026-05-18): holding at 52 clicks/week, 16,197 impressions, position 9.2 — strongest new-content performer, unchanged from last week.
- **/blog/how-to-implement-feature-flags-at-scale** (published 2026-05-26): 11 clicks, 8,276 impressions, position 7.2 — solidly in striking distance.
- **/blog/growthbook-4-4** (published 2026-05-27): 33 clicks, 2,529 impressions, position 5.9 — healthy changelog traction.
- Noticed this week (real publish dates unknown): **/blog/best-a-b-testing-platforms**, **/blog/engineering-guide-feature-flag-technical-debt**, **/blog/feature-flags-in-ci-cd**, **/blog/the-ford-2-percent-close-rate-increase**, **/insights/ab-test-ai-powered-search-recommendations**, **/insights/ab-testing-llms**, **/insights/canary-releases-ai-models-what-changes-vs-traditional-software** — none have GSC impressions yet. The AI-angle insights pages are well-timed against the Optimizely AI campaign above; promote via internal links now.

**Strategic priorities (ACP)**
- **Top-10 footprint is up 56 keywords over 3 months (now 154 top-10 rankings)** — momentum is real, but the conversion layer (BOFU comparison pages) is underperforming.
- **All 8 comparison pages need the same structural fix** (ACP 78-82, Harvest horizon): add a 40-word answer capsule + comparison table + schema markup + signup CTA. AI Overviews are present on all these queries; GrowthBook is NOT cited on vs-Optimizely, vs-VWO, vs-ABsmartly, vs-Eppo, vs-Split. These are the clearest AI-citation capture targets in the account.
- **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** (ACP 82, position 10.0, 3,297 impressions, 5 clicks/week) and **/compare/growthbook-vs-statsig** (ACP 82, position 7.2, 2,535 impressions) are the highest-priority two — GrowthBook IS cited in AI Overviews for these, meaning a structural upgrade converts existing AI authority into clicks.
- **"what is a/b testing"** (position 12.69, 817 impressions) and **"a/b testing"** (position 17.55, 2,268 impressions): AI Overviews are present, GrowthBook NOT cited. **/blog/what-is-a-b-testing** jumped +10 clicks this week — momentum to build on.

**Organic movers worth watching**
- **/blog/what-is-a-b-testing**: 19 clicks this week (up from 9) — the underlying page is gaining. Pair the ACP comparison-page fix cadence with an answer-capsule H2 on this page to capture the AI Overview for "what is a/b testing" (817 impressions, not cited).
- **/blog/a-practitioners-guide-to-treatment-effects**: 10 clicks (up from 1) — second consecutive week of growth on a high-authority stats topic. Add internal links now while momentum builds; PostHog's CUPED docs target the same audience.
- **/blog/a-b-testing-in-the-age-of-ai**: 4 clicks (down from 15) — second consecutive week of decline as Optimizely publishes a coordinated AI experimentation campaign. Needs a refresh or expansion this week.
- **/compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely**: 0 clicks this week, position 9.1, 2,255 impressions — also an AI Overview capture target where GrowthBook is NOT cited. Both problems fixable with the same structural update.
- **/insights/best-ab-testing-tools-product-analytics**: 14 clicks (up from 3) — new mover worth watching; no action needed yet.

**Recommended actions**
- **Apply the answer-capsule + comparison table + schema fix to **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** and **/compare/growthbook-vs-statsig** this week** (ACP 82 each). These two pages have AI Overviews where GrowthBook IS already cited — the structural upgrade is the conversion layer, not a ranking play. Highest ROI in the account.
- **Apply the same fix to **/compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely** this week** (ACP 80, position 9.1, 0 clicks, AI Overview present but GrowthBook NOT cited). One page, one afternoon of work.
- **Refresh **/blog/a-b-testing-in-the-age-of-ai** this week.** Down from 15 to 4 clicks while Optimizely publishes four AI experimentation assets. Add an answer-format H2 targeting "AI experimentation" to compete for the AI Overview.
- **Promote **/insights/ab-testing-llms** and **/insights/ab-test-ai-powered-search-recommendations** via internal links immediately.** These new pages directly intercept queries Optimizely and PostHog are flooding — but need internal link equity to index.
